states the USGS solubility table stops at 40.0 C, its highest tabulated temperature
states the USGS table extends down to 600 mmHg, lower than the EPA chart
states the EPA chart bottoms out around 690 mmHg

notes only the USGS chapter supplies salinity correction factors, which the EPA chart does not carry
